text:
incident-bot: ALERT: abnormal KV paging surge in us-west-2. paging_rate=15.2k/s, tenant=beta-corp showing p50->p99 jump, backend 5xx increased. AlertID: KV-PG-2057002

Priya K: paging spike acknowledged. I'm starting triage.

Jamal S: root cause hint: prefetch queue depth for prefixes /beta/ increased massively and eviction_age distribution shows older pages being evicted then re-fetched. Miss rate for /beta/ moved from 18% to 78% in 4m.

Priya K: I'm seeing `prefetch_worker OOM reclaim` and `page_read_timeout` in logs. Looks like prefetch burst causing read amplification and backend saturation.

Priya K: mitigation plan options:
- 1) regional prefetch disable (quick)
- 2) tenant soft-limit (per-tenant token bucket reduce) for beta-corp
- 3) set cache policy for /beta/* to `read-through-bypass` (ensures correctness but more backend reads)
- 4) aggressive eviction-shedding (experimental)

Priya K: executing 1) now for us-west-2
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/flags" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"flag":"runtime.prefetch.enabled","value":false,"scope":"region:us-west-2","issuer":"priya.k"}'
```

DevDeployBot: flag runtime.prefetch.enabled=false applied for region us-west-2 by Priya K (change-id chg-2057002a).

SRE-Ryan: metrics: paging_rate decreased from 15.2k/s -> 6.0k/s within 90s. backend 5xx decreased ~60%.

Priya K: applying 2) to add immediate headroom while we monitor. Setting beta-corp rps to 40 for 30m.
```bash
opsctl quota set --tenant beta-corp --rps 40 --duration 30m --note "mitigate paging surge"
```

OpsCtl: quota applied: tenant=beta-corp rps=40 duration=30m by priya.k

Jamal S: adding 3) as a precaution for correctness. Will flip cache profile for /beta/* to bypass reads to avoid inconsistent iterator errors.
```json
{"action":"cache_profile_update","scope":"prefix:/beta/*","profile":"bypass","author":"priya.k"}
```

DevDeployBot: cache profile change queued -> applied (3s). Affected prefixes: /beta/* (change-id cache-2057002b).

Jamal S: after bypass in place eviction churn dropped and iterator errors stopped. Backend read latency stable but load higher; combined with RPS cap it's within safe margin.

cust-success-Ana: pinged beta-corp: "We observed elevated errors earlier, temporary mitigations are in place (prefetch disabled, temporary rate cap, cache bypass for your prefixes). We're monitoring and will follow up with timeline and RCA." They requested any ETA for re-enabling.

Priya K: status for handoff: mitigations: prefetch disabled (us-west-2), beta-corp RPS=40 (30m), prefix /beta/* -> bypass. Observed impact: client 5xx reduced ~65%, p99 latency improving ~1.6x baseline. Customer-facing traffic impacted ~12% during peak window.

Marta L: I'm taking over in 20m. Priya please paste the dashboards to watch and the rollback commands.

Priya K: dashboards: kv/paging/us-west-2, kv/prefix-miss-rate, backend/5xx, prefetch/queue-depth. Rollback steps: re-enable prefetch flag, remove quota cap, revert cache profile to previous. Change-ids: chg-2057002a, cache-2057002b.

SRE-Ryan: follow-ups: add prefetch safety check - abort prefetch if eviction_rate > 500/min and prefetch queue growth > 1000 within 2m. Also add an alert for prefix-miss-rate > 60% for >2m.

Priya K: filing ticket ENG-RT-2057 for prefetch guards and alerting, assigning to eng-runtime + eng-telemetry.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied and system STABILIZING. Monitor window started at 2057002468. Next automated check at +10m.

Marta L: taking watch. I'll escalate if any regression. If stable for 30m we'll mark mitigated and create a postmortem draft with timeline.

Participants: priya.k, jamal.s, srer-ryan, cust-success-ana, devdeploybot
